# VoiceBee

> Voice-to-text desktop app for macOS and Windows. Hold a key, speak, and your words appear instantly in any app.

## Overview

VoiceBee is a voice dictation application that lets you type 5x faster using your voice. It works as a system-wide overlay — hold a hotkey, speak naturally, and text is inserted wherever your cursor is. It supports 99+ languages with automatic detection.

## Key Features

- **System-wide dictation**: Works in any app (email, browser, code editors, messaging)
- **Dual AI engines**: Local Whisper AI (offline, private) + Cloud STT (faster, more accurate)
- **99+ languages**: Automatic language detection powered by OpenAI Whisper
- **<2s latency**: Near-instant transcription
- **97% accuracy**: High transcription accuracy across languages
- **Live overlay widget**: Visual indicator showing recording/transcribing/done states
- **Privacy-first**: Local mode keeps all audio on your device
- **Cross-platform**: macOS 10.15+ (Apple Silicon & Intel) and Windows 10/11 (64-bit)

## Pricing

- **Free plan**: 2,500 words/week, local Whisper + cloud STT
- **Pro plan**: $10/month or $96/year (20% annual discount), unlimited words, priority cloud processing
- **Teams**: Coming soon

## Technical Details

- Built with local OpenAI Whisper model for offline transcription
- Optional cloud speech-to-text for enhanced accuracy and speed
- Minimal system resources (~50MB RAM)
- Auto-updates included
- No browser extension needed — works at the OS level
